title: Cladone Gate One usage event
description: Flat usage record emitted to out-of-process extension plugins. No tokens, cookies, raw query strings, email or username: the user is represented by an opaque subjectId (HMAC).

schemaVersion.description: Event schema version. Always 1 for this contract.

type.description: Event family. Only subscribed types are produced.

instanceId.description: Stable Gate One node identifier (one WAL per node and type).

epoch.description: Producer epoch, changed on restart/migration so consumers can detect a gap.

tenant.description: Auth provider id or logical tenant; empty for shared/public routes.

subjectId.description: Opaque deployment-scoped user identifier: versioned HMAC. Never an email or a raw IdP sub.

route.description: Normalized route pattern, never the raw URL/query.

durationMs.description: Backend or auth duration in milliseconds.

bytes.description: Response/request size in bytes, as observed by the gateway.

authResult.description: Authentication outcome for the request or auth action.

action.description: Auth action: login, login_failed, logout, backchannel_logout, revocation.

sessionId.description: Opaque RP session id for auth events.

mcpTool.description: MCP tool or operation name, when the event comes from an MCP route.

requestId.description: Gateway request id, for correlation with logs and traces.

idempotencyKey.description: Caller-provided idempotency key, copied only for billing.
